description: A script for executing the 'tsgo' tool with lock management and environment configuration. It imports necessary modules, applies policies to command-line arguments, acquires a lock before running the external process, and ensures lock release after execution.

methods.name: applyLocalTsgoPolicy
methods.description: Applies local tsgo policies to command-line arguments and environment variables.

methods.name: acquireLocalHeavyCheckLockSync
methods.description: Synchronously acquires a lock to prevent concurrent heavy checks, providing a lock release function.
